verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly recommend running multiple Devins in parallel on independent tasks. The API and Devin MCP let you create sessions programmatically, including on behalf of other users, and set up recurring schedules. Together these give an engineering lead a path to fan out work at scale. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or quotas, tooling to monitor and orchestrate many parallel sessions at once, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel throughput.
